headline.title: Sheetz is quitting VMware, migrating 11,000 virtual machines
headline.summary: Sheetz is transitioning away from VMware to StorMagic for its virtualization needs, migrating 11,000 virtual machines in the process. This shift reflects the company's strategy to enhance its IT infrastructure.

articles.title: Windows 0-day drops the same day Microsoft releases record number of patches
articles.summary: A newly discovered Windows 0-day vulnerability, named HiveLegacy, has emerged on the same day Microsoft released a record number of security patches. The vulnerability is described as a "powerful primitive" that may enable various malicious activities.

articles.title: EZSMT Version 3, Matured
articles.summary: The paper introduces EZSMTV3, an advanced framework for Constraint Answer Set Programming (CASP) that integrates Answer Set Programming with Constraint Processing and Satisfiability Modulo Theories. This new version enhances the translational approach to CASP solving, offering an extensible platform for tackling complex combinatorial search problems.

articles.title: Do Agent Optimizers Compound? A Continual-Learning Evaluation on Terminal-Bench 2.0
articles.summary: The article investigates whether gains from agent optimization methods compound over time in a continual learning context, using the Terminal-Bench 2.0 framework. It highlights that most previous evaluations focus on one-time improvements rather than the recursive application of optimization in real-world scenarios.

articles.title: LessonBench-V1: A Benchmark Dataset for Evaluating AI Lesson Generation Agents
articles.summary: The article introduces LessonBench-V1, a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate AI lesson generation agents, consisting of 647 human-written lessons and LLM-generated lesson plans across 240 STEM topics. This dataset aims to fill the gap in standardized evaluation methods for AI educational content generation systems.

articles.title: Full-Pipeline Inference Optimization for MiMo-V2.5 Series: Pushing Hybrid SWA Efficiency to the Limit
articles.summary: The article discusses a full-pipeline inference optimization for the MiMo-V2.5 model series, integrating Hybrid Sliding Window Attention (Hybrid SWA), sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE), and multimodal encoders to enhance efficiency. It highlights the engineering challenges in implementing these optimizations in production, particularly in optimizing the KVCache system.

articles.title: Boogu-Image-0.1: Boosting Open-Source Unified Multimodal Understanding and Generation
articles.summary: Boogu-Image-0.1 is a newly introduced open-source model family designed for unified multimodal understanding and generation, featuring variants such as Base, Turbo, Edit, and Edit-Turbo. It offers competitive capabilities in text-to-image generation, rapid inference, instruction-based editing, and bilingual text rendering in Chinese and English.

articles.title: RAGthoven at SemEval-2026 Task 1: A Multi-Stage Pipeline Walks Into a Benchmark and Barely Clears the Bar
articles.summary: The article introduces RAGthoven, a multi-stage pipeline system designed for the SemEval-2026 Task 1 focused on multilingual constrained humor generation in English, Spanish, and Chinese. The system utilizes a series of large language models for planning, writing, self-critique, and evaluation, grounded in established computational humor theories.

articles.title: Audited Selective Verification for Risk-Controlled N-1 Thermal Contingency Screening under Deployment Shift
articles.summary: The paper presents Audited Selective Verification, a method designed for real-time N-1 thermal contingency screening in energy management systems that balances assurance and cost. This approach aims to improve the reliability of contingency assessments by providing a statistical guarantee while addressing the limitations of traditional verification methods.

articles.title: GeoAnchor: Collaborative Reasoning via Latent Decomposition for 3D Spatial Understanding
articles.summary: The article introduces GeoAnchor, a novel approach for enhancing 3D spatial understanding by utilizing collaborative reasoning through latent decomposition. This method addresses the limitations of existing multimodal large language models in accurately interpreting 3D relationships from 2D images by employing diverse latent representations.

articles.title: UTS at ELOQUENT 2026 Voight-Kampff: structural shifts in AI writing bypass state-of-the-art detectors
articles.summary: Research presented at ELOQUENT 2026 reveals that certain language model evasion attacks can effectively bypass state-of-the-art AI writing detectors, even after adversarial fine-tuning is applied. The study identifies a key vulnerability in detectors, indicating that shifting generated text outside their training distribution can consistently defeat these systems.

articles.title: OvisOCR2 Technical Report
articles.summary: The OvisOCR2 model, a 0.8 billion parameter end-to-end document parsing system, converts document page images into Markdown representations while maintaining natural reading order. It utilizes a data engine that merges real-document annotations with synthetic pages, ensuring accurate text, formula, table, and visual region parsing.
